Dungeon Master Procedures

When no specific rule applies, the DM sets a target number on d20 (easy 5, moderate 10, hard 15, very hard 20) and applies the relevant ability adjustment. Ability checks are optional; a natural 20 succeeds and a natural 1 fails when the DM uses that convention.

Aging modifies ability scores at thresholds determined by the DM. Alignment changes require a major shift in behavior and may cause the loss of class abilities. Anti-magic areas suppress spells and magical item powers. The DM's final ruling resolves ambiguous cases.
